title: Home Purchase Financing Servicing Manual — Applying Installments, Partial Payments and Curtailments
content:
## Chapter: applying payments on a Home Purchase Financing loan

**Open loans only.** Payments are accepted only on a loan that is active or delinquent. The loan's status is read from the company's record of that loan before the payment is applied.

**Channels.** Payments are accepted through the program's accepted payment channels; card payments are never accepted.

**A full installment.** A payment of at least one full installment — the monthly principal-and-interest amount plus the monthly escrow deposit — satisfies the oldest unpaid installment:

- interest is the unpaid principal times the note rate divided by 1200, rounded half up to the cent;
- principal is the principal-and-interest amount less that interest;
- escrow is the monthly escrow deposit;
- the next due date then advances one month.

**Less than a full installment.** A payment smaller than one full installment is held in suspense, and suspense is applied as soon as it reaches one full installment.

**Money left after whole installments.** *The clause "Money left after whole installments is applied to fees owed, and any remainder is applied as a curtailment when it is at least the program's minimum curtailment amount, otherwise held in suspense" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis and is kept here only as a record.*

**Curtailments.** A curtailment reduces principal only; it never advances the next due date, and the borrower may not designate it to skip an installment. There is no prepayment penalty on a curtailment.

### Hypothetical split of one installment

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Unpaid principal before the payment | 40000.00 |
| Note rate | 9.00 percent |
| Monthly principal and interest | 360.00 |
| Monthly escrow deposit | 80.00 |
| Full installment | 440.00 |

Interest is 40000.00 times 9.00 divided by 1200, that is 300.00; principal is 360.00 less 300.00, that is 60.00; escrow is 80.00. A payment of 440.00 satisfies the oldest unpaid installment and the next due date moves forward one month. A payment of 300.00 on the same loan is held in suspense; a later 140.00 brings suspense to 440.00, and suspense is then applied.

superseded_clauses: Money left after whole installments is applied to fees owed, and any remainder is applied as a curtailment when it is at least min_curtailment_amount, otherwise held in suspense.
